purpose: Leakage-safe student splits for the 2025 calibration cohort (RF08 remediation).
split_policy: fewshot_students and irr_students must be disjoint. internal_val_students must not overlap with fewshot_students.
external_val_cohort: 2026 — hold-out cohort; no overlap with 2025 splits by design
notes: fewshot_students: source of few-shot examples in fewshot_examples_v2.json
irr_students: frames drawn from these students will form the IRR coding sample
internal_val_students: used for internal validation only; not in fewshot or IRR
external_val_cohort 2026: separate cohort; used as the deployment target, not for calibration
This split was designed for pilot purposes with N=17. Publication will require external hold-out validation on 2026 data.
